Metadata.title: Expedition projects | Mountain Tracker
Metadata.description: Private expedition planning workspace in Mountain Tracker.

List.title: Projects
List.description: Build multi-day mountain expeditions, keep the itinerary together and return to your field notes in one place.
List.emptyDescription: Projects bring several mountains, daily stages and trip notes together in a single expedition dossier.

Create.title: Plan an expedition
Create.description: Create the field dossier now. Add dates to generate one itinerary day per calendar day, or leave them open for later.
Create.nameHelp: Use a clear expedition name, up to 120 characters.
Create.datesHelp: Both dates are required together. A dated project can contain up to 60 days.
